name: workday
description: A Today pane with your events, tasks and alerts, and a /wrapup report at the end of the day. Works with whatever tools are connected.

sources.title: Preferred sources
sources.description: Which tools to use, for example 'Jira, Google Calendar, Sentry'. Leave empty to use whatever is connected.

dayStart.title: Workday start
dayStart.description: HH:MM. Start of the progress bar.

dayEnd.title: Workday end
dayEnd.description: HH:MM. End of the progress bar.

focusCount.title: Focus: tasks shown
focusCount.description: Tasks listed in the Focus card before '+ N more' (1–20).

maxAlerts.title: Heads-up: items shown
maxAlerts.description: Heads-up items listed before '+ N more' (1–20).

maxEvents.title: Timeline: events shown
maxEvents.description: Events in the Timeline card (1–30). It starts with the last event before now.

staleAfter.title: Stale after (minutes)
staleAfter.description: After this many minutes the pane says its data is stale and suggests /today. 0 turns it off.

refreshOnStart.title: Refresh on start
refreshOnStart.description: On by default: every new start of Claude Code runs /today once on its own (reloading plugins does not), unless the data is less than 15 minutes old or the pane is turned off. Each run is one Claude request.

autoRefresh.title: Auto-refresh (minutes)
autoRefresh.description: 0 = off. Otherwise /today runs by itself every N minutes (at least 15), only during the workday, with the pane on screen and nothing typed. Each run is one Claude request.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: calm (teal, indigo, amber, coral), nordic, warm, theme (follows your Claude Code theme) or mono.

colorWorkday.title: Color: Workday card
colorWorkday.description: A hex value like #ff8800 or a theme name like success, warning, claude. Leave empty to use the palette.

colorTimeline.title: Color: Timeline card
colorTimeline.description: A hex value like #ff8800 or a theme name like success, warning, claude. Leave empty to use the palette.

colorFocus.title: Color: Focus card
colorFocus.description: A hex value like #ff8800 or a theme name like success, warning, claude. Leave empty to use the palette.

colorHeadsUp.title: Color: Heads-up card
colorHeadsUp.description: A hex value like #ff8800 or a theme name like success, warning, claude. Leave empty to use the palette.
